decisions.statement: One `c<N>` launcher is composed for each Anthropic model account page.
An account page stating no alias index has no launcher.
Every launcher in the set composes the set again by calling this.
The set is composed whole on every call rather than kept between calls.
The set goes to the report.
A shell evaluates the output stream.
One line of the set is one line of the report.
A word given to this command is refused.
The accounts are read from the pages rather than from a snapshot beside those pages.
Reading no account is a data refusal rather than a set with no launchers.
Nothing here writes a file or starts a seat.
A terminal reaches its own functions only where this command can be read.

definition: the command composing the bash a terminal sources
